data.name: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG
data.detailed_description:
This Place at the End is a turn-based RPG about survival, ambition, and impossible choices in the face of apocalypse. Civilization clings to life on four floating continents, secretly ruled by ancient dragons disguised as mortals, and one now tips the scales in an effort to gain immortality. 

You're an adventurer on the remains of the planet, Geodia, ruins housed in a pocket dimension where humanity's last societies struggle under corporate empires, monarchies, scavenger clans, and gangs. Their survival is fragile, their rulers untrustworthy. And now, a mad lich has arrived, demanding the king's head.

You have 30 hours, 30 in-game days, to decide how to accomplish this task.

Choose from twelve radically different outcomes: align with rival dragon factions, back revolutionary uprisings, preserve memory and culture, attempt to unite splintered peoples, or refuse to act at all. There are several valid ways to reach the end.

The world is defined by people clinging to their own forms of survival:

  • A king seeking godhood to escape mortality.

  • A young girl pushing forward under the weight of inherited tradition.

  • A desperate crew planning one final strike with a cosmic payload.

  • A war hero who lived past her last battle and now searches for what comes after.

After the world was torn apart, rebuilding became the only option. Pre-apocalypse technology is rare, maintained by the few who still remember how to work it, and it sits beside steel swords and scavenged tools. Magic and technology bleed together in improvised forms as people struggle to reclaim what was lost.

This Place at the End offers no clear heroes and no pure villains. Only people, bound by flawed systems, making impossible decisions with whatever time they have left.

KEY FEATURES

  • Choose from 12 distinct endings with different gameplay styles

  • Create a party of 8 from 12 unique classes and 24 class variant recruits

  • Engage in difficult, turn-based combat with positioning, QTE timing mechanics, and an emphasis on buff/debuff management

  • An extensive In-game TCG based on Triple Triad to sink invaluable time into

  • Craft and enchant gear, hunt and cook food for a variety of buffs, and manage your time wisely
